title: Fluorine-free dialkylphosphate-based ionic liquids as supercapacitor electrolytes
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00217F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sayantika Bhakta, Gaurav Tatrari, Andrei Filippov, Faiz Ullah Shah
We introduce several fluorine-free ionic liquids (ILs) comprising dialkylphosphate anions coupled to pyrrolidinium, piperidinium, and pyridinium cations. These ILs exhibit promising performance as supercapacitor electrolytes.
